Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the customer mobile app shall display the updated points balance on the member's next balance request.
Rationale: Members check the app right after paying; a stale balance drives support tickets (S-03).

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the updated balance shall be available to the customer mobile app within TBD seconds.
Rationale: "Quickly" in LOY-118 needs a measurable target; open question Q1 to SH-01.

Text: IF the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall keep the points of that purchase in pending state until the fraud engine releases the hold.
Rationale: Prevents fraudulent points from being redeemed before review.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall send a push notification to the member with the points earned.
Rationale: Reinforces the earning moment; channel choice is open question Q2.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall send an email to the member with the points earned.
Rationale: Split from the push requirement in LOY-118; whether both channels are wanted is open question Q2.
